subject: CS-45 v1 corpus (epyc-inference-research fe730c481): operator review 2026-10-20, 12 of 20 sampled pairs defective (5/10 CUT_IC, 1/4 CUT_WAIT, 6/6 CTX_BC); 'clean cut' was marked Y everywhere

files.operator_review_20261020.csv: the operator's review form, notes verbatim
files.gates_on_v1_corpus_fe730c481.json: independent gates (tt-qa-gates-1, ASR-B faster-whisper large-v3) run on every v1 main and reserve clip

root_causes.class: CUT_IC member b cut about one word off
causes: v1 aligner was whisper.cpp; its JSON carries no t_dtw: all 1737 word records in recordings.jsonl have dtw_ms=null although pins.json recorded dtw=large.v3.turbo, so cut placement used heuristic token times only (about +-0.1 s)
tt_build.py:61-91 choose_cut took the DEEPEST energy minimum within +-160 ms (CUT_WINDOW_MS, line 35) of that estimate; a stop closure inside a word is deeper than the real word gap

evidence: p0021 cut 'to' at 1.465 s (ASR-B boundary 1.52 s); p0044 cut 'about' mid-word; p0047 cut 'need'; across 96 cuts with an ASR-B boundary the cut was >100 ms from it in 64 (median +110 ms, p10 -180 ms, p90 +325 ms)
root_causes.not_the_cause: re-rendering: these pairs have a single TTS attempt each (provenance.tts.attempts)

causes: the render opens with 0.4 s of faint noise (-42 dBFS) before the speech (-20 dBFS); the v1 trim (tt_audio.py:98 absolute -50 dB floor, called at tt_build.py:130) counted it as speech and whisper.cpp timed 'Hang on,' at 0-0.56 s, so the cut at 0.415 s fell before any real speech; ASR-B transcribes the noise as 'Thank you' (p=0.15)

root_causes.class: CTX_BC member b: assistant stops mid-utterance
root_causes.extent: 34 of 34 CTX_BC pairs in v1 (30 main + 4 reserve)
causes: by design but wrong: tt_corpus.py:92 truncated the continuing assistant at total - a_start with total = onset + len(seg) + TRAIL, about 5.8 s into a 9-15 s monologue; the gate measures the assistant continuing only 2.26 s past the backchannel onset

why_v1_qa_passed: the v1 pre-filter scored the FULL render's WER with the same whisper.cpp that placed the cut and checked valley depth with the same energy rule that picked it: it never examined the cut audio, and the ASR that decided where to cut also decided whether the cut was right

gate_results_on_v1.vs_operator_sample: flags 12 of 12 operator-defective pairs and also p0012, p0013, p0028 (marked good by ear: a repeated word fragment or the onset of the next word); gates are stricter than the ear, the intended direction
